course.title: React — From Beginner to Professional
course.description: A visual-first, project-based React course covering the complete supplied 333-lesson syllabus, from JavaScript foundations through production UI, testing, accessibility, modern APIs, rendering architectures, security, deployment, and professional engineering.
course.version_scope: Course examples reference React 19.3 as documented by the official React blog on 2026-09-09. The existing CodeLeaf frontend manifest uses React/React DOM 18.3.1; the platform dependency was intentionally not upgraded by this content patch. Snippets for newer APIs require a separate version-matched learning project. Framework-only/server features must be checked against the selected framework version.
prerequisites: JavaScript variables, functions, objects, arrays, modules, and async/await
learning_outcomes: Build reusable function components with JSX, props, and composition.
Manage state and forms predictably, and reuse behavior with Hooks.
Integrate routing and APIs with robust loading, error, and accessibility states.
Test, debug, measure, and improve React applications.
Choose suitable client/server rendering architecture, respect security boundaries, and deploy maintainable applications.

integration_notes: Uses the existing backend/scripts/import_course_files.py file-based course importer; no alternate content engine or database migration was added.

The course remains draft pending human review. Run the importer dry-run first; use --apply only after review and --publish only after the course metadata, all module/lesson files, question sets, and exercises are approved.
Code examples are tagged static-validation. CodeLeaf’s playground is not an arbitrary React/Node execution sandbox; test snippets in a local Vite project or the specified toolchain.
The platform backend remains the authority for the fixed XP policy and authenticated progress; this package contains no XP overrides or user activity totals.
